## Before submitting

Please confirm the following:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions to make sure this has not already been suggested.
- [ ] This request is related to Pacearr.
- [ ] I understand that roadmap items and feature requests are not guarantees of implementation.

## Feature summary

Provide a short, clear description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem or use case

What problem would this feature solve?

Describe the situation where the feature would be useful and why the current behaviour or workflow does not meet your needs.

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think the feature could work.

You do not need to provide a technical implementation. Explain the behaviour you would like to see from a user's perspective.

## Example workflow

If applicable, describe how you imagine using the feature.

For example:

1.
2.
3.
4.

## Area of Pacearr

Which part of Pacearr does this request relate to?

- [ ] Release discovery
- [ ] Download clients
- [ ] Importing / file organization
- [ ] Metadata / posters
- [ ] Plex
- [ ] Jellyfin
- [ ] Emby
- [ ] Configuration / settings
- [ ] Web UI
- [ ] Notifications
- [ ] Docker / deployment
- [ ] Migration / compatibility
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives considered

Have you found another way to achieve the same result?

If so, describe the workaround or alternative and why the proposed feature would be preferable.

## Compatibility considerations

Would this feature affect existing Pacearr installations, configuration variables, persistent state, media paths, or compatibility with OnePacerr-derived deployments?

If you are unsure, you can leave this section blank.

## Additional context

Add any other information that may help explain the request, including screenshots, examples, links to relevant documentation, or similar behaviour in other applications.
